data.scope_limit: Debug images were previously used for engineering checks and are not a fresh independent holdout.

preprocessing.loader: OpenCV BGR uint8 decoded file; verify decoded dimensions against metadata.
preprocessing.tensor: BGR to RGB, HWC to contiguous CHW, batch axis; canonical CPU FP32 divide by255 exactly once, then transfer/cast to respective CUDA dtype.
preprocessing.same_input: FP16 input must be canonical FP32 input converted to half; record FP32 input SHA and exact letterbox integer padding/gain per image.
preprocessing.predictor_equivalence: Not claimed: default predict rect=True can generate rectangle; default predictor fuses and clips. No default-predict/raw numerical comparison.

model.layout: B,C,N; first4 pixel xywh in letterbox640 domain, then10 independent sigmoid class scores, no objectness channel
model.raw_extraction: tuple[0] for eval output; fail unexpected layout rather than silently transpose or truncate.

numerical_policy.domain: All decoded coordinates and all10 class scores at all8400 anchors for each of109 images; no confidence mask for raw tolerance.
numerical_policy.required_finite: All saved model floating state, both inputs and both decoded outputs finite; raw widths/heights positive and scores within[0,1].
numerical_policy.pass: All required prerequisites and all images pass shape/finite/all-element bounds; zero tolerated out-of-bound values.
numerical_policy.failure: Preserve failed evidence, mark numerical qualification failed/incomplete; do not relax bounds, fuse, change checkpoint, retrain or tune using debug outcomes automatically.

nms.input: independent detached CPU FP32 clone of decoded output; raw comparison/summary completed before NMS mutates input
nms.truncation: record output count reaching1000 and any NMS time-limit warning; no silent censoring

postprocessing.box_restoration: xyxy subtract recorded integer left/top pad then divide by recorded gain; keep raw original-coordinate boxes unclipped for category0 raster filter. Do not use default scale_boxes xyxy clipping before evaluator.
postprocessing.adapter: class_id0..9 +1; bbox_xywh=[x1,y1,x2-x1,y2-y1] from original coordinates, preserve floating coordinates and detection order.

postprocessing.reporting: Per-dtype target hits/misses, same-target hit differences and false-positive/ignore counts are diagnostics under this project policy. NMS count/order equality and target-hit equality are not substituted for raw allclose. Disclose threshold/NMS boundary differences.

evidence.per_image: source SHA, tensor shape/input hash, gain/pad, output shape/dtype/finite, separate box/score maximum error and allclose fail counts, postNMS count, project matching summaries
evidence.artifacts: Frozen contract/runner, source and environment records, selected checkpoint SHA, per-image metrics JSONL, aggregate qualification verdict, raw and postprocessing diagnostic failures.
